serviceName: Website and email for your domain
description: Points the customer's domain at their Inflowave website and authenticates the domain for sending email (DKIM and return path). Groups: website (A records on the applied host), www (A records on www, only when applied to a root domain), email (three CNAME records minted per domain by the mail platform).
variableDescription: %emid%: digits of the per-domain mail return-path label (em<digits>), minted per domain by the mail platform. %sguser%: the per-domain mail platform account label (u<digits>) used in the CNAME targets.
